description: Rebecca has been a champion of small businesses in our community which are critical to both the economy and the livelihood of so many of our neighborhood families. Rebecca has cosponsored legislation that suspends all rent payments for certain residential and small business commercial tenants and certain mortgage payments for ninety days due to COVID-19. …

title: Small Businesses - Rebecca Seawright
